model.ambient_bath: T_loc(z) = T0(1+z) — corpus clock-map temperature-depth relation
model.ionization_supply: ambient bath LyC Wien tail: Gamma = c sigma_LyC n_gamma(>nu_L;T), integrated numerically over Planck
model.ontological_note: The front is a photoionization phase boundary in the depth-rising ambient field — not a density wall, not a recombination era.  Below it the ambient bath is too cool to sustain ionization (neutral trough); above it the ambient field keeps the medium plasma (the eternal deep zone).  The wing is ionized separately by local sources (Gate-12 UVB), so the eternal structure is ionized -> neutral -> ionized: two ionized phases separated by a self-shielded trough.

assumption_bounds.unshielded: the computed x_e(z) applies the full local Planck LyC tail at every depth — an upper bound on trough ionization
assumption_bounds.shielding_direction: the trough is LyC-saturated (tau_LyC ~ 2e10); local depletion of the ambient tail suppresses leading-edge x_e, pushing both z_front and the tau=1 crossing deeper than the unshielded values reported here

verdict: The eternal boundary is computed from the ambient bath rather than parametrized: the bath LyC Wien tail crosses the recombination balance at z_front ~ 914 (diffuse n_b0) to 1053 (5e3 n_b0 absorber density), a density-controlled ionization front with width ~113 in z — a Saha-type transition, not a razor edge and not a shell.  On the unshielded profile the Thomson tau = 1 crossing sits at z ~ 752 (front-column density) — a shallower bound, since trough self-shielding suppresses the leading-edge ionization and moves both the front and the surface toward the observed z ~ 1080 at absorber densities.  Residual items: LyC transfer through the self-shielded trough (sets the front's true sharpness and exact depth), the medium density at the front (absorber-statistics inversion), and the perturbation mode spectrum on the front.
